description.value: Smitty's Oyster House is an independent waterfront seafood restaurant in Gibsons on British Columbia's Sunshine Coast, self-described as 'the institution on the water.' The menu centres on a rotating selection of fresh raw and broiled oysters alongside Dungeness crab, sablefish, scallops, and other Pacific and East Coast seafood. It is a distinctly local spot — the OSM record explicitly flags it as unrelated to the Smitty's breakfast chain — making it a notable destination meal for cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast.
